models.name: TF-IDF + Logistic Regression
models.architecture: Subword & Word N-Gram (1-3) TF-IDF Vectorizer with L2-Regularized Multinomial Logistic Regression
models.description: High-efficiency multilingual baseline using subword char n-grams to handle agglutinative morphology and orthographic variations across Indian languages.
models.strengths: Sub-millisecond latency, zero GPU requirement, robust across low-resource vocabulary overlap.
models.limitations: Lacks deep contextual semantic representations and negation scope tracking in long compound sentences.

models.name: XLM-RoBERTa Multilingual
models.architecture: Cross-lingual RoBERTa (12 layers, 768 hidden, 12 heads, 250k SentencePiece BPE vocabulary)
models.description: State-of-the-art cross-lingual masked language model pre-trained on 2.5TB of filtered CommonCrawl data covering 100 languages including major Indian languages.
models.strengths: Deep cross-lingual contextual representations, strong zero-shot transfer across language families.
models.limitations: High parameter count and compute footprint; sub-optimal subword segmentation on lower-resource Indic scripts compared to native Indic models.

models.name: IndicBERT (AI4Bharat)
models.architecture: ALBERT-based parameter-sharing multilingual model pre-trained on IndicCorp (12 layers, 768 hidden, 12 heads)
models.parameters: ~12 Million (ALBERT architecture with shared layer parameters)
models.description: Compact multilingual model explicitly engineered for Indian languages, trained on 9 billion tokens across 12 Indic languages with native Indic vocabulary.
models.strengths: Compact footprint (~33MB weights), faster inference, superior morphological tokenization for Dravidian and Indo-Aryan scripts.
models.limitations: Limited support for English-dominant code-mix without joint English-Indic alignment.
